name: doclap/home-process
title: Home — Process
description: Numbered process steps from first question to final polish.

default.title: Understand before you draw.
default.copy: Ask the right question. Find the essence of the brand, the user and what the experience really needs to solve.

default.title: Find a language of its own.
default.copy: From the type system and colour to layout. Try different directions, then keep the one with the clearest reason.

default.title: Give design a life.
default.copy: Program, animate and refine directly in the browser. How it feels to use matters as much as a static image.

default.title: Care to the very end.
default.copy: Check every screen size, interaction state and accessibility path. Polish even the things that are hard to notice.
